targets.expr:
(sum (count_over_time({job="connext_logger"} |= "EMERGENCY" |~ "(?i)$dds_guid" [$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum (count_over_time({job="connext_logger"} |= "ALERT" |~ "(?i)$dds_guid" [$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum (count_over_time({job="connext_logger"} |= "CRITICAL" |~ "(?i)$dds_guid" [$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum (count_over_time({job="connext_logger"} |= "ERROR" |~ "(?i)$dds_guid" [$__range])) or vector(0))
